te: Blackchin tilapia (part 2): the Cooperative Promotion Department gives information
se: The meeting invited the Cooperative Promotion Department to give information on its role under the memorandum of understanding on tackling blackchin tilapia. The committee observed that the work is still limited to a few provinces and should be extended to other affected areas, and proposed releasing the large stock of bio-fermented liquid still held, so that the funds can be recycled to keep buying the fish
it: The spread of blackchin tilapia

te: Work of the cooperative and food security subcommittees followed up
se: The meeting noted that the cooperative subcommittee will meet jointly with the Senate's subcommittee on finance on the oversight of savings cooperatives and credit unions, and that the food security subcommittee is studying pesticide residues in food, where several gaps in oversight were found
it: Progress of the subcommittees on cooperatives and on food security

te: Blackchin tilapia (part 1): the Rubber Authority of Thailand and the Land Development Department give information
se: The meeting considered the spread of blackchin tilapia and invited the Rubber Authority of Thailand and the Land Development Department to give information. They reported that the affected area has shrunk, and that the fish is being removed and put to use, such as in fishmeal and bio-fermented liquid, with predator fish released and fish sterilisation techniques under research
it: The spread of blackchin tilapia

te: Outline set for the integrated beef cattle study, and a cattle identification system
se: The meeting considered Si Sa Ket Province's proposal to develop the beef cattle supply chain; the outline of the study report on integrated beef cattle breed improvement and marketing strategy (chain and data management, breeds and standards, marketing and exports); and pushing a beef cattle identification system (NID) for traceability. It also considered matters from the Senators Meet the People project and replies from agencies
it: Outline of the study report on integrated beef cattle breed improvement and marketing strategy
Pushing a beef cattle identification system (NID) for traceability
Matters from the Senators Meet the People project, and replies from agencies

te: Drought (part 11): experts describe alternating drought and flood
se: The meeting invited experts on climate change and disasters to give information. They said Thailand is vulnerable to climate change, heatwaves are tending to become more severe, and weather may swing from drought to flood in the same area more often, which affects food security and the farm economy
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically and sustainably

se: The meeting noted information that Thailand has a high drought risk compared with other countries, and that several provinces in the Northeast are at high risk in the next 10 years. It also noted the National Adaptation Plan (NAP) of the Department of Climate Change and Environment, which includes measures on water management, agriculture and food security
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically: the climate change dimension

te: Dairy farmers' request for an inquiry, and a water matter in Chumphon, received
se: The meeting considered a petition from a group of dairy farmers asking for help and for the matter to be looked into, alleging that they have been affected by the management of the Dairy Farming Promotion Organization of Thailand. It noted progress on water management in Chumphon Province, which the Royal Irrigation Department has assigned to Regional Irrigation Office 14 to consider, and considered a request to follow up local budgets and a matter from the Senators Meet the People project in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya Province
it: Petition from a group of dairy farmers
Progress on water management in Chumphon Province
A request to follow up local budgets, and a matter from the Senators Meet the People project

te: A petition from Ayutthaya rice farmers alleging contaminated water, and matters from the public in several regions, received
se: The meeting considered a continuing matter in which farmers in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya Province say they cannot grow rice because of contaminated water from a chemical fertiliser plant, as alleged. It noted the 2026 budget allocations relevant to the committee, and considered petitions from the Senators Meet the People project in the upper South (Nakhon Si Thammarat) and the lower Northeast, such as the operation of the Pak Phanang basin floodgates, low crop prices and flooding
it: Petition from farmers in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya Province about contaminated water
2026 budget allocations relevant to the committee
Petitions from the Senators Meet the People project, upper South and lower Northeast

te: Petitions from people in the South on fish cages and oil palm received
se: The meeting considered petitions from the Senators Meet the People project in Krabi, Phang Nga and Phuket Provinces asking to extend aquaculture zones and to delay orders to remove structures and fish cages. It felt that letters should be sent to the Permanent Secretary for Transport, the Director-General of the Department of Fisheries and the Governor of Phuket Province to ask for the facts. It also considered the Trang Provincial Farmers Council's proposal to develop the oil palm industry
it: Petitions from the Senators Meet the People project: aquaculture zones and orders to remove fish cages
Proposal to develop the oil palm industry in Trang Province

te: Briefing by the Rice Department and the Department of Agriculture on rice variety certification
se: The meeting invited the Director-General of the Rice Department and the Director-General of the Department of Agriculture to give information on registering and certifying rice varieties. In short, private-sector breeding is advancing fast while state processes have not kept up, which creates limits, such as on describing varieties and on certifying seed quality
it: Registering and certifying rice varieties, and support for the rice production system

te: Changes proposed to the school milk rules, and the drought report followed up
se: The meeting noted the results of the dairy subcommittee's discussion with the Cooperative Promotion Department on the school milk (supplementary food) programme. The committee proposed changing the rules for allocating quotas and sales areas, promoting milk drinking, extending milk-drinking days to cover the whole year and widening the groups who receive milk, to help absorb surplus milk. It also noted progress on the report on approaches to solving drought problems systematically and sustainably
it: Rules and procedures of the school milk (supplementary food) programme
Draft study report on approaches to solving drought problems systematically and sustainably

te: The draft Dairy Cattle Act and ways to cut dairy farming costs followed up
se: The meeting noted the dairy subcommittee's report that the House of Representatives' ad hoc committee has finished considering the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ...., with amendments similar to the subcommittee's proposals but differing on 2 points: the make-up of the board and the rules of the school milk programme. It also noted approaches to cutting costs, raising raw milk quality and widening markets, and the results of study visits
it: Progress of the study of the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ....
Approaches to cutting dairy farming costs and widening markets for dairy products

te: Briefing on a project to grow Japanese rice in the Northeast
se: The meeting noted the progress of the farmer debt and integrated rice subcommittees, which are preparing their reports, and invited a grower of Japanese rice in Thailand to give information on a project to grow Japanese rice in the Northeast to international standards, so that it can compete and earn income for farmers
it: Progress of the farmer debt and integrated rice subcommittees
Growth prospects for Japanese rice in Thailand

te: Drought (part 9): the Department of Water Resources and the Office of the National Water Resources give information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Department of Water Resources and the Office of the National Water Resources to give information on dry-season measures, such as forecasting areas at risk of water shortage, allocating water and planting areas, saving water and strengthening water user organisations
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 8): the Department of Local Administration gives information
se: The meeting considered approaches to solving drought problems systematically and invited the Department of Local Administration to give information on the role of local authorities in supplying water for household use and farming, coping with drought and floods, and the regulations that allow local bodies to help low-income farmers
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically

te: Drought (part 7): the Department of Agricultural Extension gives information on the planting calendar
se: The meeting invited the Department of Agricultural Extension to give information on the planting calendar, the management of farm areas and water, and the crop disaster analysis centre. It felt a letter should be sent to the Department of Lands asking about progress on land title deeds in Na Yong District, Trang Province, and it noted the progress of the subcommittees
it: Approaches to solving drought problems systematically
Rights to apply for land title deeds, Na Yong District, Trang Province
Progress of the subcommittees (farm household debt · dairy cattle · integrated rice)
